verdict.rationale: The only relevant item is a single tagline on ClickUp's developer portal, "Trigger workflows from ClickUp events" [clickup-docs-3]. It implies an event-subscription mechanism alongside the Public API, but it never names webhooks or describes how to subscribe. Missing for 10: explicit webhook documentation (create/list/delete webhook endpoints), supported event types, payload format, signature verification, retry semantics, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
